projects.title: promptlint
projects.tagline: A static linter for LLM prompt templates — catches f-string injection, unbalanced braces, and unsafe role boundaries before you ship.
projects.long_description: promptlint scans your prompt templates the way ESLint scans JavaScript: it builds an AST of every Jinja / f-string template in your repo, finds unsafe interpolation points (user data inside system messages, unescaped tool-call payloads, dangling role tags), and emits actionable diagnostics. Ships as a CLI, a pre-commit hook, and a GitHub Action. Used in production by ~40 teams at the time of this listing.
